title: Line-Plan Customer Goodwill on Rental Billing Corrections
content:
**Goodwill rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts re-rating correction carries a line-plan customer goodwill rate read from the landlord's Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans holdings.

| Active utility line protection plan held by the landlord | Premium payments posted on the landlord's line plans in the 12 months before the correction | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 0.04 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | 0.02 |
| no | any | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Utility Line Protection Plans records: the landlord's line plans and their status, and the premium payments posted in the line plans' billing history, with their dates.

**How the rate acts.** Every goodwill rate on a re-rating correction is added to one in a single sum, and the correction is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* an active line plan with 3 payments posted in the 12 months: 0.02; with 12: 0.04.
